feedback.label: bundled-modular-wrong
feedback.text:
Here’s the correction.

Your answer: Less carbon dioxide is absorbed directly by chlorophyll

Correct answer: Less light energy is absorbed to drive electron transfer

Chlorophyll absorbs light energy that drives electron transfer in photosynthesis. Making much less chlorophyll reduces this light capture; chlorophyll does not absorb carbon dioxide or split oxygen.
Try this transfer: This links a visible input (light) to the first energy-conversion step.
